description: Without signing in: the basic reading guide: the core terms and the rules for reading the data correctly. Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: the basic reading guide: the core terms and the rules for reading the data correctly. With a QuantGeeks plan: the complete guide: the full course, the field manual, and every term, rule and checklist. Reading rules for QuantGeeks data; call it before interpreting a board. With `query` (a term such as primary node, gamma flip, roll, VEX, or any words) it returns the entry or the closest sections, each with an id. With `section` (an id from a previous lookup) it returns that whole section. Give exactly one. It never labels a pattern itself.
name: quantgeeks_lookup_guide
title: Look up the reading guide
